style: VISUAL SYSTEM (tier 2, identical across a set of four game screens): calm studio frame, modern and masculine. Flat graphite base (#14171a), panels are flat dark slate rectangles with a thin 1 px hairline border and 10 px corners; NO glow, NO haze, NO light streaks, NO lens flares. Headings in a heavy condensed sans (upper case for kickers), body in a clean modern sans, generous spacing. Signal red is used ONLY on the one primary button and the active tab underline; everything else is white, light grey or muted green-grey. Imagery sits INSIDE panel frames, full-bleed to the frame edge with a dark gradient at the bottom for type: game renders of 3D rooms and rigged 3D characters (stylised real-time 3D game render look, not photographs). No real brands, no logos except a small 'TOPS' wordmark, no real people, no flags. Portrait phone screen 390x844, App Store quality, crisp fully legible text spelled exactly as given. Header bar on every screen: 'TOPS' wordmark, 'Hayden', a thin level bar labelled 'Lv 14', '$640', an envelope icon with a small '3' badge, a menu icon. Under it a tab rail: TONIGHT · SEASON · SHOP · LOCKER · PRACTICE (active tab white with a red underline, others grey).

Then one small line 'Goal: average 61+ → $40'.
